notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). Resolve $poolManager to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the just-deployed SIMDTEST. Deploy the hook itself by CREATE2 with flags 0x20cc. Its constructor creates its fixed rewardRouter; no wrapper or additional configuration. Entire 1e27 token supply mints to the factory, which handles 90% pool seeding and the 10% swarm allocation externally. Static 12500 LP fee plus a 2% IMD hook fee. Buyers using rewardRouter (payer equals recipient) accrue 1% of actual IMD spent including hook fees for buys >=10e18. Other routers trade with fees but no unauthenticated rewards. Sell swaps never earn rewards. Partial fills cap the fee using a reverting PoolManager preview; exact-input buys include the fee in their budget, exact-output sells specify net IMD. Fees accrue in IMD or manager ERC-6909 claims if an immediate transfer fails. collectFees redeems claims to the hook; claimRewards and permissionless payRecorded pay only the beneficiary, outside all manager unlocks. Surplus fees remain permanently in the hook; no owner, sweep, upgrades, or mutable parameters. initialPrice is provenance only; the factory sets the economic opening price.
